columns.validationmsg: 'Sale Price should be greater than zero'
columns.name: saleprice

columns.validationmsg: "Item flat disc should be equal or greater than zero"
columns.name: itemflatdisc

columns.validationmsg: 'Claimable Discount % value should be between 0 and 100'
columns.name: claimablediscperc

table.retrieve:
SELECT
	saledetail.saleinvcode, 
	SaleDetail.AlternateCustomICode,
	saledetail.gcode,   
	location = space(100),
	saledetail.itemmetercode,
	saledetail.meterreading,
	saledetail.icode,   
	saledetail.batch,   
	saledetail.expiry,   
	saledetail.manfdate,
	saledetail.rowgroup,
	retailprice=0.00,
	Id = saledetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
	looseqty = saledetail.looseqty,
	packqty  = saledetail.packqty,
	packunits= saledetail.packunits,
	saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,
	clonesaleprice = saledetail.saleprice,
	Clonediscperc = saledetail.clonediscperc,
	discperc = saledetail.discperc,  
	pricepolicyapplied = 0,
	rate     = saledetail.rate,  
	avgprice = saledetail.avgprice,  
	LatestNetRate=0.00,
	salestax = saledetail.salestax, 
	Due      = saledetail.Due,
	PreDiscPerc=ROUND( (Saledetail.itemflatdisc / CASE WHEN Saledetail.SalePrice > 0 THEN Saledetail.SalePrice ELSE 1 END) * 100, 2),
	cloneitemflatdisc = saledetail.cloneitemflatdisc,
	itemflatdisc = saledetail.itemflatdisc,
	SatisfiedDate = saledetail.SatisfiedDate,
	saledetail.packqtyforsale,
	saledetail.bonuspackqtyforsale,
	stock = 0.0000, 
	itempacking=(SELECT IP.Name FROM ItemPacking IP WHERE IP.Packcode=saledetail.icode),
	packingdesc=space(50),
	totalstock = 0.0000,
	saleorderrowid = saledetail.saleorderrowid,
	salerowid=saledetail.salerowid,
	issuerowid=saledetail.issuerowid,
	RefusalSaleRowID = saledetail.RefusalSaleRowID,
	sourcesaleinvcode=saledetail.sourcesaleinvcode,
	saledetail.packprice,
	saledetail.purunitrate,
	saledetail.rppunitrate,
	saledetail.BatchCost,
	saledetail.alternatepurprice,
	itemalertcode = 1,
	UnitWeight = 0.000,
	PackingFactor = 0.000,
	PackCapacity = 0.0000,
	AreaVolume = 0.00000000,
	Width = Saledetail.Width,
	Length = Saledetail.length,
	RatePerLength = Round(saledetail.saleprice / 1, 2),
	PCS=0.000000,
	Cartons=SPACE(100),
	headerno = (SELECT Item.HeaderNo FROM Item WHERE Item.ICode = SaleDetail.ICode),
	saledetail.SaleUtn,
	SaleItemDescription =  saledetail.SaleItemDescription,
	InsCode =  saledetail.InsCode,
	DescICode =  saledetail.DescICode,
	claimable=saledetail.claimable,
	claimablediscperc=saledetail.claimablediscperc,
	balancestock=saledetail.balancestock,
	godownbalancestock=saledetail.godownbalancestock,
	taxflag = 1,
	unitsalestax=saledetail.unitsalestax,
	PackSalePrice = saledetail.PackSalePrice,
	totalpieces = saledetail.totalpieces,
	piecesinhand = saledetail.piecesinhand,
	commissionperunit=saledetail.commissionperunit,
	commissionperc=saledetail.commissionperc,
	gstperc=saledetail.gstperc,
	YourLotNo = saledetail.YourLotNo,
	YourExpiry = saledetail.YourExpiry,
	YourPacking = saledetail.YourPacking,
	SaleTypeCode=1,
	SaleCatCode=1,
	taxable = 'N',
	ItemAdvanceTaxPerc = saledetail.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,
	bonusqty=saledetail.bonusqty
	
FROM 
	saledetail
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode )

ORDER BY 
	saledetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_detaildwtotal
objects.expression: sum((  ( looseqty *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc) )  +   ( packqty *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc) * packunits ) ) *  ( 1-  (  discperc  *  .01 )  )  for all)

objects.name: c_totaldiscount
objects.expression: sum(looseqty * itemflatdisc for all) + if(rate - saleprice > 0, sum(looseqty * (rate - saleprice) for all), 0) + sum( round(((saleprice - itemflatdisc)*discperc*0.01)*looseqty,2) for all)

objects.name: c_sumtaxval
objects.expression: Sum ( Round( unitsalestax * ( looseqty + bonusqty ), 2) for all )

objects.name: c_sumgstval
objects.expression: Sum ( Round(( ((  ( looseqty  *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc))  +   ( packqty *  (saleprice -  itemflatdisc ) * packunits ) ) *  ( 1-  (  discperc  *  .01 )  ) ) * gstperc * 0.01),2)  for all )

objects.name: c_itemtotal
objects.expression: (  ( looseqty  *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc))  +   ( packqty *  (saleprice -  itemflatdisc ) * packunits ) ) *  ( 1-  (  discperc  *  .01 )  )

objects.name: c_gstval
objects.expression: Round(( ((  ( looseqty  *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc))  +   ( packqty *  (saleprice -  itemflatdisc ) * packunits ) ) *  ( 1-  (  discperc  *  .01 )  ) ) * gstperc * 0.01),2)
